description: A square pad you drag to set two voltages at once, each axis either dragged by hand or driven by its own CV input

params.text: Adds a steady -5V to 5V to that axis after the range has been applied, so it works the same whichever range is chosen
Sets the voltage range an incoming CV is read across before it is mapped onto the pad's own -5V to 5V: -5V to +5V, 0V to +10V for a MIDI CC converter, 0V to +5V, or -10V to +10V

inputs.text: The CV for that axis; while a cable is patched here it replaces the pad position, except for as long as you are dragging the pad

outputs.text: That axis's position plus its offset knob, lightly smoothed to take the steps out of a stepped CV or a jerky drag

notes: click anywhere in the square to jump the crosshair straight there, drag to move it, and double-click to return both axes to the centre at 0V.
dragging the pad takes control back from a patched CV for as long as the mouse is down, and the CV takes over again when it is released.
if the pointer leaves the square while you drag, the crosshair stops at the edge rather than sliding along it.
the pad itself is one widget with no parameter behind it, so clicking it cannot reach a note of its own.

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the pad position for that axis.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the pad position for that axis.
